issues.display_title: Issue #1843: Proxy GET /copilot/admin/actions/{slug} to GoThru RAG Service
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Admin proxy endpoint in GoThru-API-New to fetch full details and Markdown content of a specific knowledge action document from gothru-rag (GET /actions/{slug}).

Specification

  • Route: GET /copilot/admin/actions/{slug}
  • Auth: auth middleware + Superuser validation (CopilotAdminValidator)
  • Upstream: Proxies to GET {GOTHRU_RAG_BASE_URL}/actions/{slug} with X-Admin-Key header
  • Parameters: slug (string, required)

Response (200 OK)

Returns action metadata (file_name, title, timestamps) and full Markdown content. Returns 404 Not Found if slug does not exist.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Endpoint restricted to authorized admins (403 for non-admins).
  • Injects X-Admin-Key and forwards request upstream.
  • Returns structured action detail wrapped in standard response envelope.
  • Handles not found (404) and upstream failure states gracefully.
  • Full unit, action, controller, and route test coverage.

Result & Verification

  • PR: Merged via #1845.
  • Live Verification (https://apil.gothru.co):
    • Admin Call (adamnurdin01@gmail.com): 200 OK — Successfully retrieved document details and full markdown body for existing slug.
    • Non-Existent Slug: 404 Not Found (action_not_found).
    • Non-Admin User Call (muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com): 403 Forbidden (COPILOT.FORBIDDEN).
    • Missing / Invalid Auth: 401 Unauthorized.
  • Test Suite: 100% pass across all unit and route test suites.

issues.display_title: Issue #1848: feat(tours): Add foverlay and goverlay schedule timestamp columns and indexes to tours table
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Add database timestamp columns and indexes to the tours table in hosted_tours database to support auto-scheduling for both Hosted Overlay (foverlay) and Google Overlay (goverlay) without extra status tracking columns.

Database Schema Changes

  • Target Database: hosted_tours
  • Target Table: tours
  • New Columns:
    • Hosted Overlay Schedule (foverlay):
      • fschedule_activate_at (DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL): Scheduled timestamp to activate foverlay.
      • fschedule_deactivate_at (DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL): Scheduled timestamp to deactivate foverlay.
    • Google Overlay Schedule (goverlay):
      • gschedule_activate_at (DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL): Scheduled timestamp to activate goverlay.
      • gschedule_deactivate_at (DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL): Scheduled timestamp to deactivate goverlay.
  • Indexes:
    • idx_tours_fschedule_act on (fschedule_activate_at)
    • idx_tours_fschedule_deact on (fschedule_deactivate_at)
    • idx_tours_gschedule_act on (gschedule_activate_at)
    • idx_tours_gschedule_deact on (gschedule_deactivate_at)

DDL Script

ALTER TABLE `tours`
ADD COLUMN `fschedule_activate_at` DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL AFTER `foverlay_activate_date`,
ADD COLUMN `fschedule_deactivate_at` DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL AFTER `fschedule_activate_at`,
ADD COLUMN `gschedule_activate_at` DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL AFTER `goverlay_activate_date`,
ADD COLUMN `gschedule_deactivate_at` DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL AFTER `gschedule_activate_at`,
ADD INDEX `idx_tours_fschedule_act` (`fschedule_activate_at`),
ADD INDEX `idx_tours_fschedule_deact` (`fschedule_deactivate_at`),
ADD INDEX `idx_tours_gschedule_act` (`gschedule_activate_at`),
ADD INDEX `idx_tours_gschedule_deact` (`gschedule_deactivate_at`);

Acceptance Criteria

  • DDL script prepared and verified.
  • Columns added to tours table.
  • Relates to #1847.

Result

issues.display_title: Issue #1856: fix: forward role field in photographer apply endpoint
issues.main_description_html:
🐛 Bug Fix: Forward role field in photographer apply endpoint

Problem

Calls to POST /photographers/apply failed with a 400 Bad Request from the downstream photographer service:

{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Validation failed: role must be one of photographer_360, image_processing",
    "reason": "apply_failed"
  }
}

Root Cause

Even though the client provided role in the payload, it was dropped before reaching the downstream service:

  1. ApplyPhotographerController stripped role via $request->only([...]).
  2. ApplyPhotographerDto did not have a $role property and excluded it in toPayload().

Solution

  • Controller: Added role to $request->only() and added validation rule required|in:photographer_360,image_processing.
  • DTO: Added $role property to ApplyPhotographerDto, mapped in fromArray(), and forwarded in toPayload().

Files Changed

  • app/Http/Controllers/Photographers/Profiles/ApplyPhotographerController.php
  • app/DTOs/Photographers/ApplyPhotographerDto.php

Result

  • Changes committed & pushed to main (d658482fa).
  • The role field is now validated locally (photographer_360, image_processing) and forwarded properly in the payload to the downstream photographer service.
  • POST /photographers/apply no longer fails with validation error on role.

issues.display_title: Issue #1849: feat(tours): Implement POST and DELETE API for Virtual Tour Schedules (foverlay & goverlay)
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Implement API endpoints for setting, updating, and cancelling activation/deactivation schedule timestamps for both Hosted Overlay (foverlay) and Google Overlay (goverlay). Supports specifying tour_key to target a specific tour when a moderation contains multiple tours.

Endpoints

  1. Set / Update Schedule:
    • Route: POST /virtualtours/schedule
    • Auth: Required (auth middleware)
    • Payload: 
      {
  "moderation_id": 12345, // accepts moderation_id or mid
  "tour_key": "abcxyz", // optional if mid has only one tour, required/recommended for disambiguation
  "overlay_type": "hosted", // "hosted" (foverlay) or "google" (goverlay)
  "schedule_activate_at": "2026-09-15 09:00:00", // nullable
  "schedule_deactivate_at": "2026-09-20 18:00:00" // nullable
}
  2. Cancel Schedule:
    • Route: DELETE /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}
    • Auth: Required (auth middleware)
    • Query Parameters:
      • tour_key (string, optional): Pinpoints the tour if moderation has multiple tours.
      • overlay_type (string, optional, default: "hosted"): "hosted" | "google" (clears timestamps to NULL for the designated overlay)

Business Logic & Constraints

  • Support both overlay_type = "hosted" and "google".
  • Enforce ownership validation via checkModerationOwnership.
  • Enforce plan access control (Pro / Agency / SubAccount subscriptions via SubscriptionHelper::isProOrAgencySubscription).
  • DateTime validation: Valid format Y-m-d H:i:s, must not be in the past.
  • schedule_deactivate_at must be later than schedule_activate_at (if both provided).
  • Persists timestamps directly to tours table:
    • For hosted: updates fschedule_activate_at and/or fschedule_deactivate_at.
    • For google: updates gschedule_activate_at and/or gschedule_deactivate_at.
  • Manual override check:
    • If user manually toggles POST /virtualtours/active, clear fschedule_activate_at = NULL and fschedule_deactivate_at = NULL.
    • If user manually toggles POST /virtualtours/goverlay/active, clear gschedule_activate_at = NULL and gschedule_deactivate_at = NULL.

Architecture (ADR)

  • DTOs: SetTourScheduleDto, CancelTourScheduleDto
  • Actions: SetTourScheduleAction, CancelTourScheduleAction
  • Repositories: ToursRepository
  • Controllers: SetTourScheduleController, CancelTourScheduleController

Acceptance Criteria

  • Handles independent schedule setting/cancelling for both hosted and google overlays.
  • Supports tour_key targeting for moderations with multiple virtual tours.
  • Validates subscription permissions and tour ownership.
  • Manual active toggles clear the respective overlay schedule timestamps.
  • Full unit and feature tests covering hosted and google overlay scheduling.
  • Relates to #1847.

Result

  • PR: #1853 (feat/tour-scheduler-set-api-1849)
  • Endpoints:
    • POST /virtualtours/schedule: Set/update schedule with strict Y-m-d H:i:s validation and Pro/Agency subscription gating.
    • DELETE /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}: Cancel/clear active schedule timestamps (NULL).
  • Overrides: Manual active toggles in VirtualToursController automatically reset pending schedule timestamps.
  • Tests: 100% passing across DTO, Action, Controller, and Route unit test suites.

issues.display_title: Issue #1850: feat(tours): Implement GET API for Virtual Tour Schedule Timestamps (foverlay & goverlay)
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Provide an API endpoint for Frontend clients to retrieve current schedule timestamps for both Hosted Overlay (foverlay) and Google Overlay (goverlay). Because a single moderation_id can have multiple virtual tours, tour_key is supported as a query parameter.

Specification

  • Route: GET /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}
  • Auth: Required (auth middleware)
  • Query Parameters:
    • tour_key (string, optional): Specific tour key under the moderation ID. If omitted, falls back to the default/first tour of the moderation.
  • Response Format (Encrypted GoThru Standard Envelope): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "tour_key": "abcxyz",
    "moderation_id": 12345,
    "foverlay": {
      "is_active": true,
      "activate_at": "2026-09-15 09:00:00",
      "deactivate_at": "2026-09-20 18:00:00"
    },
    "goverlay": {
      "is_active": false,
      "activate_at": null,
      "deactivate_at": null
    }
  }
}

Architecture (ADR)

  • DTO: GetTourScheduleDto
  • Action: GetTourScheduleAction
  • Repository: TourScheduleRepository / ToursRepository
  • Controller: GetTourScheduleController

Acceptance Criteria

  • Accepts optional tour_key query parameter to pinpoint a specific tour when multiple tours exist for a moderation_id.
  • Returns timestamps for both foverlay and goverlay.
  • Returns null values when no schedule timestamp is set.
  • Verifies user ownership before returning data.
  • Unit & Feature tests covering timestamp output and tour_key selection.
  • Relates to #1847.

Result

  • PR: #1854 (feat/tour-scheduler-detail-api-1850)
  • Endpoint: GET /virtualtours/schedule/{mid} (Auth Bearer JWT)
    • Returns encrypted envelope containing overlay active states (foverlay, goverlay) and scheduled timestamps (activate_at, deactivate_at).
    • Supports optional ?tour_key query parameter to disambiguate multi-tour moderations.
    • Enforces moderation ownership check.
  • Verification: Verified via automated test suites and confirmed with live API tests on https://apil.gothru.co (HTTP 200 with valid decrypted payload).
  • Tests: 100% passing across DTO, Action, Controller, and Route unit test suites.

issues.display_title: Issue #1851: feat(cronjob): Implement Cronjob API Endpoint for Tour Scheduling (foverlay & goverlay) and Email Alerts
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Implement an API-triggered cron worker following existing repository patterns (in routes/cronjobRoutes.php) to process independent activation and deactivation schedule timestamps for both Hosted Overlay (foverlay) and Google Overlay (goverlay), clearing timestamps upon execution and triggering email alerts via Plunk (EmailClass) upon deactivation.

Specification

  • Route: GET /cronjob/process-tour-schedules
  • Query Parameters:
    • dry_run (boolean, optional, default false): Preview scheduled actions without writing to database.
    • type (string, optional, default all): "all" | "hosted" | "google"
    • limit (integer, optional, default 100): Max batch size per pass.

Execution Flow

  1. Hosted Overlay Processing (foverlay):
    • Auto-Activate:
      • Query tours where fschedule_activate_at IS NOT NULL AND fschedule_activate_at <= NOW() AND foverlay_active = '0'.
      • Update: foverlay_active = '1', foverlay_activate_date = NOW(), deactivate_date = '0', fschedule_activate_at = NULL.
    • Auto-Deactivate:
      • Query tours where fschedule_deactivate_at IS NOT NULL AND fschedule_deactivate_at <= NOW() AND foverlay_active = '1'.
      • Update: foverlay_active = '0', deactivate_date = NOW(), fschedule_deactivate_at = NULL.
  2. Google Overlay Processing (goverlay):
    • Auto-Activate:
      • Query tours where gschedule_activate_at IS NOT NULL AND gschedule_activate_at <= NOW() AND goverlay_active = '0'.
      • Update: goverlay_active = '1', goverlay_activate_date = NOW(), gschedule_activate_at = NULL.
    • Auto-Deactivate:
      • Query tours where gschedule_deactivate_at IS NOT NULL AND gschedule_deactivate_at <= NOW() AND goverlay_active = '1'.
      • Update: goverlay_active = '0', gschedule_deactivate_at = NULL.
  3. Plunk Email Notification:
    • For tours deactivated (hosted or google), send an alert email using EmailClass::send() with the Plunk template registered in #1852, passing relevant tour & user parameters.

Response (200 OK)

{
  "status": "ok",
  "dry_run": false,
  "hosted": {
    "activated": 2,
    "deactivated": 1
  },
  "google": {
    "activated": 1,
    "deactivated": 0
  },
  "emails_sent": 1,
  "email_failed": 0
}

Acceptance Criteria

  • Registered endpoint under routes/cronjobRoutes.php.
  • Processes foverlay and goverlay independently by clearing executed timestamps to NULL.
  • Supports dry_run mode.
  • Dispatches Plunk email alerts on deactivation via EmailClass.
  • Automated tests for worker sweeps and notification triggers.
  • Depends on #1852.
  • Relates to #1847.

Result

  • PR: #1855 (feat/tour-scheduler-cronjob-worker-1851)
  • Endpoint: GET /cronjob/process-tour-schedules
    • Automated worker (TourScheduleWorker) sweeping overdue activation and deactivation schedules for hosted and google overlays.
    • Clears executed timestamps (NULL) to ensure idempotency.
    • Supports type=all|hosted|google, configurable limit, and dry_run simulation mode.
    • Dispatches deactivation email alerts via Plunk (EmailClass::send()) with template UID 10316328-d2ad-49fb-93ec-539f5ad279e4.
  • Verification: Verified via unit tests (100% passing) and live testing on https://apil.gothru.co for dry-run, auto-activation, auto-deactivation, and email dispatch to user inbox.
  • Tests: TourScheduleWorkerTest (6 tests, 32 assertions) and TourScheduleCronjobRoutesTest.

issues.display_title: Issue #1858: [Proxy] GET photographers/professional-services -> GoThru Maps backend
issues.main_description_html:
Context

GoThru API New (Lumen 9) needs to expose the photographer "professional services" read feature by proxying to the GoThru Maps backend (Go). No local DB/business logic — forward the request to BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER and relay the response.

Authenticated user id ($request->user_id, injected by existing auth middleware) is used as the upstream gothruUserId. No path param required — matches the existing services route group pattern in routes/photographerRoutes.php.

Upstream contract (Go backend — gothru-maps-backend-go)

GET /v1/photographers/:identifier/professional-services where :identifier is numeric (gothru_user_id) or slug. No upstream auth middleware.

  • Query param disablecache=true|false (optional; default caches 24h upstream in Redis).
  • Response 200:
{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestTime": 5,
  "data": {
    "professionalServices": [
      {"id":1, "icon":"hdr-blending", "name":"HDR Blending", "link":"https://example.com/samples/hdr", "order":1}
    ]
  }
}
  • Errors: 404 {"data":{"error":"Photographer not found"}}, other 500.

Requirements (this repo, ADR-Domain per docs/ARCH_RULES.md)

Theme: proxy only — no local persistence, validation, cache, or auth logic.

  1. Route — in the existing photographers group (auth applies) in routes/photographerRoutes.php, following the services prefix style: GET photographers/professional-services. Resolve gothruUserId from $request->user_id.
  2. Service — app/Services/Photographers/<Name>Service.php: base URL from env(BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER) (match existing PhotographerServicesService), use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http with sensible timeouts. getProfessionalServices(int $gothruUserId, bool $disableCache): array → GET upstream, pass disablecache; return normalized [success=>bool,data=>mixed,statusCode=>int].
  3. Action — one class (e.g. GetProfessionalServicesAction), one execute(); throw a Domain exception when !$result[success].
  4. Controller — one class (e.g. GetProfessionalServicesController), one handle() using $request->user_id as gothruUserId, return via ResponseEnvelopeHelper. Relay upstream status/error through the Photographers domain exceptions (not-found → 404; pass upstream error body/status through).
  5. Exceptions — add a not-found exception mapping to 404 and upstream-failure mapping where not already present; wire into PhotographersExceptionHttpMapper.

Out of scope

  • Do not re-implement upstream validation. Let upstream return errors and relay them.
  • PUT endpoint is tracked in a separate issue.

Acceptance criteria

  • GET photographers/professional-services returns upstream services through the standard envelope (statusCode, data.messages, data.professionalServices).
  • Upstream 404/500 relayed with correct HTTP status and message.
  • Follows ADR naming/suffix rules (machine-checked in CI per ARCH_RULES §8).
  • Uses BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER for the upstream URL; no hardcoded hosts.

Related (upstream implementing the endpoint)

gothru-maps-backend-go:

  • src/routes/v1/photographersRoutes.go
  • src/controllers/v1/photographers/professionalServices.go (GetProfessionalServices)
  • src/action/v1/photographers/professionalServices.go (GetProfessionalServices)

Result

Implemented and verified in PR: #1862

Changes

  • Route: GET photographers/professional-services registered in routes/photographerRoutes.php under the authenticated photographers group.
  • Service: app/Services/Photographers/ProfessionalServicesService.php::getProfessionalServices forwarding to BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER/v1/photographers/{userId}/professional-services with connectTimeout(5) and timeout(10), error handling for ConnectionException (503), safe root-level error fallback, and disablecache query passthrough.
  • Action: app/Actions/Photographers/GetProfessionalServicesAction.php orchestrating service call and throwing ProfessionalServicesFetchFailedException with preserved upstream status code.
  • Controller: app/Http/Controllers/Photographers/Services/GetProfessionalServicesController.php supporting authenticated $request->user_id, SuperUser ?sid= impersonation query param, and returning standardized ResponseEnvelopeHelper::responseMessages.
  • Exception & Mapping: ProfessionalServicesFetchFailedException registered in PhotographersExceptionHttpMapper (maps to 422 default or preserved upstream status e.g. 404/502/503).
  • Tests:
    • tests/Actions/Photographers/ProfessionalServicesActionsTest.php: unit tests for action, disablecache passthrough, upstream status preservation, connection exception handling, and root error fallback.
    • tests/Http/Controllers/Photographers/GetProfessionalServicesControllerTest.php: integration tests for controller response envelope, superuser ?sid=, and upstream 404 relay.
    • tests/Exceptions/Photographers/PhotographersExceptionHttpMapperTest.php: exception mapper test coverage.

issues.display_title: Issue #1859: [Proxy] PUT photographers/professional-services -> GoThru Maps backend
issues.main_description_html:
Context

GoThru API New (Lumen 9) needs to expose the photographer "professional services" save feature by proxying to the GoThru Maps backend (Go). No local DB/business logic — forward the request to BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER and relay the response.

Authenticated user id ($request->user_id, injected by existing auth middleware) is used as the upstream gothruUserId. No path param required — matches the existing services route group pattern in routes/photographerRoutes.php.

Upstream contract (Go backend — gothru-maps-backend-go)

PUT /v1/photographers/:identifier/professional-services where :identifier is numeric (gothru_user_id) or slug. No upstream auth middleware; a image_processing role check runs inside the PUT service layer.

  • Request body (missing/null services → upstream 400):
{
  "services": [
    {"icon":"hdr-blending", "name":"HDR Blending", "link":"https://example.com/samples/hdr"},
    {"icon":"object-removal", "name":"Object Removal", "link":""}
  ]
}
  • Validation (upstream, rejects → 400): max 20 items; name required ≤150 chars; icon optional matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$; link optional absolute http(s) ≤2048 chars; empty string → stored as NULL. Role not image_processing → 400 "Professional services are only available for image_processing photographers".
  • Response 200:
{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "message": "Professional services saved successfully",
    "professionalServices": [ ...same item shape as GET... ]
  }
}
  • Upstream side effects: full replace (delete+insert, one txn), Redis cache invalidation, async ranking recompute + status revert-to-pending.
  • Errors: 404 {"data":{"error":"Photographer not found"}}, 400 with upstream error message, other 500.

Requirements (this repo, ADR-Domain per docs/ARCH_RULES.md)

Theme: proxy only — no local persistence, validation, cache, or auth logic.

  1. Route — in the existing photographers group (auth applies) in routes/photographerRoutes.php, following the services prefix style: PUT photographers/professional-services. Resolve gothruUserId from $request->user_id.
  2. Service — app/Services/Photographers/<Name>Service.php: base URL from env(BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER) (match existing PhotographerServicesService), use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http with sensible timeouts. replaceProfessionalServices(int $gothruUserId, array $services): array → PUT upstream with {services:[...]} body; return normalized [success=>bool,data=>mixed,statusCode=>int].
  3. Action — one class (e.g. ReplaceProfessionalServicesAction), one execute(); throw a Domain exception when !$result[success].
  4. Controller — one class (e.g. ReplaceProfessionalServicesController), one handle() using $request->user_id as gothruUserId, return via ResponseEnvelopeHelper. Relay upstream status/error through the Photographers domain exceptions (not-found → 404; 400 with upstream message; pass others through).
  5. Exceptions — add a not-found exception mapping to 404 and upstream-failure mapping where not already present; wire into PhotographersExceptionHttpMapper.

Out of scope

  • Do not re-implement upstream validation (icon/link/name/role). Let upstream return errors and relay them.
  • GET endpoint is tracked in a separate issue.

Acceptance criteria

  • PUT photographers/professional-services forwards the request services body and relays upstream 200 (message + professionalServices).
  • Upstream 400 (validation + role), 404, and other errors relayed with correct HTTP status and message.
  • Follows ADR naming/suffix rules (machine-checked in CI per ARCH_RULES §8).
  • Uses BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER for the upstream URL; no hardcoded hosts.

Related (upstream implementing the endpoint)

gothru-maps-backend-go:

  • src/routes/v1/photographersRoutes.go
  • src/controllers/v1/photographers/professionalServices.go (ReplaceProfessionalServices)
  • src/action/v1/photographers/professionalServices.go (ReplaceProfessionalServices)

Result

Implemented and verified in PR: #1862

Changes

  • Route: PUT photographers/professional-services registered in routes/photographerRoutes.php under the authenticated photographers group.
  • Service: app/Services/Photographers/ProfessionalServicesService.php::replaceProfessionalServices forwarding full {services: [...]} replace payload to BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER/v1/photographers/{userId}/professional-services with connectTimeout(5) and timeout(10), connection error resilience (503), and safe root-level error fallback.
  • DTO: app/DTOs/Photographers/ReplaceProfessionalServicesDto.php capturing gothruUserId and sequential list services according to ARCH_RULES.md ADR-Domain standard.
  • Action: app/Actions/Photographers/ReplaceProfessionalServicesAction.php receiving DTO and throwing ProfessionalServicesReplaceFailedException with preserved upstream status code (e.g. 400 for validation or role check failure).
  • Controller: app/Http/Controllers/Photographers/Services/ReplaceProfessionalServicesController.php validating input is a sequential array (array_is_list), mapping to DTO, and returning standardized response envelope.
  • Exception & Mapping: ProfessionalServicesReplaceFailedException registered in PhotographersExceptionHttpMapper (maps to 409 default or preserved upstream status e.g. 400).
  • Tests:
    • tests/Actions/Photographers/ProfessionalServicesActionsTest.php: unit tests for replace action, DTO execution, upstream 400 status preservation, and connection exception handling.
    • tests/Http/Controllers/Photographers/ReplaceProfessionalServicesControllerTest.php: integration tests for success replace envelope, missing services 400, non-sequential array 400, and upstream 400 relay.
    • tests/Exceptions/Photographers/PhotographersExceptionHttpMapperTest.php: exception mapper test coverage.

issues.display_title: Issue #1861: feat(schema): add keycloak_sub column to users table (executed on production)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

DB schema change required by Keycloak login integration (#1860). Executed manually by the operator — no migration code in this repo (database/migrations is intentionally kept empty per project convention).

SQL

ALTER TABLE users
    ADD COLUMN keycloak_sub VARCHAR(255) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
    ADD UNIQUE INDEX uk_users_keycloak_sub (keycloak_sub);

Notes

  • keycloak_sub = stable Keycloak identity claim (sub) of the user — never changes, unlike email. Used by /v1/auth/keycloak-login to resolve/link the GoThru user.
  • NULL by default: existing users (registered via email/password) have no Keycloak identity yet; the column is populated by the API on first Keycloak login (auto-link by verified email).
  • Unique index guards against two users linking to the same Keycloak sub and keeps the lookup O(1).
